about: The fixed list of word changes of 3.0.0 (D-242, design of 3.0.0 section 5.6, step 3): what a written file of 2.x says that the same file of 3.0 says otherwise. {L} and {L2} stand for a revision letter and {V} and {V2} for its version by the mapping of section 5.5; {*} is any text, kept; {field} is one field of a CSV line, kept; {^} is the start of a line. A scope of `item` replaces whole text items of a drawing, `cell` whole cells of a workbook (in the sheets named, if any), `text` matches in the text of a file. `after` names the item that must come just before (the title block field). The entries apply in the order of the list; tests/test_format3.py fails on any other difference and on an entry that matches nowhere.
